content.title: About
content.content: An egg sandwich on white bread is a simple dish consisting of a boiled or fried egg placed between two slices of soft white bread. Often seasoned with salt, pepper, mayonnaise or mustard. It’s a quick, nutritious snack popular in cafés and home kitchens.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first recorded egg sandwich dates back to the early 20th century when bread and eggs became widely affordable.
In the United States the egg sandwich is a common breakfast item served at many chain cafés.
White bread gives a soft texture, but it can be swapped for whole‑grain bread for added fiber.
Eggs are one of the cheapest sources of high‑quality protein.
The sandwich is easily customizable with bacon, cheese, avocado, or herbs.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Eggs provide all essential amino acids, supporting muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Source of vitamin D
items.content: The yolk is one of the few natural food sources of vitamin D, important for bone health.

items.title: Contains vitamin B12
items.content: Vitamin B12 supports nervous system function and red blood cell formation.

items.title: Provides choline
items.content: Choline in eggs is vital for brain function and fat metabolism.

items.title: Low in carbs
items.content: A white‑bread sandwich offers moderate carbohydrate content, making it a quick energy snack.

items.title: Egg allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to egg whites, ranging from skin rashes to anaphylaxis.

items.title: Cholesterol content
items.content: The yolk contains cholesterol; people with high cholesterol should monitor egg intake.

items.title: Gluten in bread
items.content: White bread contains gluten, which can be problematic for those with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Adding sauces like mayo or mustard can increase sodium, which may be a concern for hypertension.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The sandwich can be enjoyed hot or cold. Eggs may be boiled hard, soft‑boiled, or fried. Season with salt, pepper, herbs, and sauces to taste. For a healthier version, use whole‑grain bread and add lettuce or tomato.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the prepared sandwich in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours, wrapped in plastic film. It’s best to cook the egg fresh before eating to maintain flavor and texture.
